title: False Horizon Adept
text: False Horizon Adept bends distant landmarks into a convincing route that ends inside its waiting hands. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The shortest path is the one that never existed.

defeatReward.text: False Horizon Adept is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
